title: Polished Corundum
description: Overhauls the Corundum textures in the mod "Quark".
body:
# Polished Corundum
This is a resource pack that modifies the textures of the Corundum blocks from the mod [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark).
Most assets come from the mod [Effective Crystals](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/effective-crystals), with permission from TriQue.

## Credits
- [TriQue](https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/trique/projects) - Effective Crystals Author
- [Vazkii](https://modrinth.com/user/Vazkii) - Quark Author
